record.field: ( object.env._('Rental Quote - %s') % (object.name) if (object.is_subscription or object.plan_id) and object.state in ('draft', 'sent') else object.env._('Rental Order - %s') % (object.name) if (object.is_subscription or object.plan_id) and object.state not in ('draft', 'sent') else object.env._('Quotation - %s') % (object.name) if object.state in ('draft', 'sent') else object.env._('Order - %s') % (object.name) )
